description: A web-based user interface for visualizing and browsing databases, tables, and their data. It includes HTML structure, embedded CSS styles, and JavaScript for dynamic data loading and interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses a database to show/hide its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and displays it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data into an HTML table with scrollability and interactive cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expandability.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell's full content on click.
